projects.project_name: SAV: CC - HYUNDAI MOTORS SAVANNAH AKA. PROJECT EA
uncertainties: Multi-component project including construction of multiple substations (Hyundai, Newton Rd) and multiple transmission lines (Hyundai - Newton Rd 230kV, Hyundai - Meldrim 230kV, Interstate Centre - Hyundai 115kV).
Page 177 list showed Need Date 1/1/2025; detail sheet on page 231 specifies Need Date 04/25/2025.
Document contains CEII and confidential notifications; costs and supporting statement are redacted.

evidence.text:
SAV: CC - HYUNDAI MOTORS SAVANNAH AKA. PROJECT EA
Teams # 19523
Need Date 04/25/2025 Start Date 06/01/2022

Construct a new Hyundai 230kV substation with an eight element 230kV ring bus and four 230/25kV banks. Construct a new Newton Rd 230kV substation with a five element 230kV ring bus and loop through the Little Ogeechee - Meldrim Black and White 230kV lines. Build two new 230kV lines connecting from Hyundai - Newton Rd (12 miles) and Hyundai - Meldrim (10 miles). At Meldrim, add a breaker to accommodate for the new Hyundai line. Install a 115/25kV bank at Interstate Centre and build a new 115kV line from Interstate Centre - Hyundai (2.3 miles) for bridge power.
